text: Rory Mensah fired in a stunning long-range goal for Redmond Rovers from 27 meters out, assisted by Kian Coleman after a slick team move with six passes in just 20 seconds starting from a free kick [#689] [#690]. This goal leveled the score at 1-1 after Redmond had been trailing, showing their patient build-up and quick passing finally broke down Ironvale Athletic’s strong defense. Mensah’s shot had a low chance of scoring (xG 0.023, meaning it usually goes in about 2 times out of 100), but it paid off thanks to Redmond’s smart and steady play [#690]. With 57% possession and almost 89% pass accuracy, Redmond’s style of pressing and quick ball movement really made the difference here.
